record.question: A kite is flying with a string 150m long. It makes an angle of 30° with the horizon. The height of the kite from the ground is
record.explanation: The taut 150 m string is the hypotenuse of a right triangle. Height=150×sin30°=150×1/2=75 m, option C, assuming the string starts at ground level as the question implies. Verified worked solution; unofficial.
